purpose: Execution and evidence matrix only; this file never changes TODO status.

0.27.0.use: Generate ten real 0.27 final-state saves for 0.28 migration.

pre-0.24.2.prohibition: Do not synthesize, flag-edit, or relabel a later save as this fixture.
pre-0.24.2.needed: Original issue autosave.eu4 or a real pre-0.24.1 release plus engine-generated failing save.

global_invariants: Obtain explicit user permission before starting EU4, dowser, or Paradox Launcher.
Use ordinary copied snapshots under the EU4 user mod directory; never junctions or repository paths.
Use a dedicated isolated playset containing exactly the descriptors declared for the session.
Exclude Graphical Map Improvements, the Chinese localisation mod, and every unrelated mod.
Use main-only for existing saves and 0.27 fixture generation; companion map always requires a new campaign.
Create a before-session record, then collect fresh logs, named JXP_ACC_ saves, and screenshots after exit.
Debug scaffolds accelerate setup but never substitute for natural triggers, formal mission rewards, UI clicks, save serialization, or engine rendering.

scenarios.title: Current release cold start
steps: Pause immediately and capture map, mission tree, and government state.
Advance one day and then a second day to allow startup migration and two-phase mission refresh.
Save as JXP_ACC_R1_BASELINE.eu4, exit, and collect fresh logs.
acceptance: No crash or parse/unknown-object errors.
Five custom mission columns and expected reform state are present after day two.
No mission.cpp:353 or national_idea8 error.

scenarios.title: Five daimyo profile UI matrix
scenarios.fixture: new 1444 starts for RKK, KYO, HNM, DHO, TGS
steps: Open each representative warrior, court, maritime, frontier, and temple-market profile.
Advance two days and inspect missions, national ideas, and government reforms.
acceptance: Each profile has five non-generic mission columns and its six-node map house series.
Each idea group is start plus seven ideas plus bonus with no overlap.
No missing icon, wrong tier, disconnected edge, empty hole, or text collision.

scenarios.title: Ten final-state UI and lifecycle matrix
scenarios.fixture: branches from one disposable unified-Japan save
steps: Use the debug menu to construct uncommitted, Sakoku, Open, KJP, CJP, EJP, RFJ, SJP, IJP, and WAK states.
For each state inspect immediately and after one day, then capture missions, ideas, and reforms.
Perform at least one JAP-route to JAP-route and one final-tag to final-tag transition.
acceptance: Exactly one matching power structure is active in every state.
Only the matching five-series mission signature and seven-idea group are active.
Old power structures and permanent political capstone modifiers clear across transitions.

scenarios.title: Real 0.27 ten-state migration
scenarios.playset: 0.27 main-only to generate; current main-only to migrate
steps: Create a stable 0.27 uncommitted baseline and branch it before any route forcing.
Generate each state independently, advance two days, complete one shared and one route mission, save/reload, and save again.
Load each input under 0.28, advance two days, save/reload, and advance two more days.
evidence: ten input/output save pairs with SHA-256
one fresh log per migration batch
acceptance: Route/tag, completed missions, unique ideas, unique power structure, and five-column tree survive.
No DOM/BOM or foreign route series remains active.
jxp_final_state_power_migration_v0280 settles once and remains stable after reload.

scenarios.title: Historical pre-0.24.2 serialized-state regression
steps: Acquire the original problem autosave or a real pre-0.24.1 failing engine save.
Record its unmodified hash before loading; never seed flags or edit serialization.
Load under current, advance, save/reload, and inspect missions and ideas.
acceptance: No mission.cpp:353, BOM-prefixed live series, or national_idea8.
Historical completed missions remain intact.
scenarios.external_blocker: Repository starts at 0.25.0 and local saves contain no JXP metadata; this fixture cannot be honestly generated from current assets.

scenarios.title: CJP harmonization and native center behavior
steps: Enter CJP and allow the normal Confucian setup event to create native centers.
Verify Shinto harmonizes once, exactly three native centers are possible, and Ise province 4359 stays protected.
Observe at least one natural engine conversion and exercise Neo-Confucian, urbanization, and Nanban bridge entries.
acceptance: Shinto is not harmonized repeatedly.
Ise remains Shinto and never hosts a Confucian center.
Bridge events fire in CJP without duplicating their source chains.

scenarios.title: WAK long-term pressure loop
scenarios.fixture: new WAK disposable campaign plus observer branch
steps: Exercise all three investments, 50 and 85 pressure thresholds, dividend and crisis events, and both exits.
Save/reload mid-cycle, then leave the route and advance one day to verify cleanup.
Run an AI observer sample without debug forcing outcomes.
acceptance: Finite modifiers do not stack permanently and both exits close the cycle.
Route loss clears active state.
Companion jxp_map_compat_wokou_waters scope behaves as intended.

scenarios.title: IJP congregation-pressure loop
scenarios.fixture: new IJP disposable campaign plus observer branch
steps: Exercise all three governance choices, 50 and 85 thresholds, petition and crisis events, and both exits.
Save/reload mid-cycle and verify route-loss cleanup.
Prove the entry is unavailable during Shimabara or another active disaster and returns after cleanup; run an AI observer sample.
acceptance: IJP does not overlap Shimabara or another active disaster.
Finite modifiers and cycle flags close on either exit or route loss.
Companion jxp_map_compat_ikko_heartland scope behaves as intended.

scenarios.title: Toyotomi formal transition and date boundaries
scenarios.fixture: disposable ODA campaign prepared by debug scaffold but transitioned by production decision
steps: Use jxp_debug_prepare_toyotomi_decision, set the date to 1586, and click jxp_decision_assume_toyotomi_name itself.
Inspect before/after tag, flag, name, ideas, missions, Five Regents reform, and subjects; save/reload.
acceptance: The formal decision performs ODA to TOY; the scaffold never performs the transition.
TOY flag/name/seven-idea group/six-node mission series/Five Regents identity survive reload.
Map owner, core, and subject transitions match the dated plan.

scenarios.title: Hakko Ichiu with Mandate of Heaven
scenarios.playset: current main-only with Mandate of Heaven enabled
scenarios.fixture: two disposable Japanese campaigns for both unlock orderings
steps: Test emperor-first then normal mission unlock, and mission-first then emperor acquisition.
The emperor debug scaffold may transfer the Mandate but must not unlock or pass Hakko; complete the real mission and click the real reform.
Compare a fixed East Asian province under a normal conquest CB and cb_jxp_hakko_ichiu, then execute the peace. Test locked and foreign-emperor negatives.
acceptance: Hakko is invisible before mission unlock and visible only to an eligible Japanese emperor.
The reform passes through the celestial UI and grants the CB after reload.
Allowed East Asian demands show 0.5 attacker AE relative to the baseline CB.

scenarios.title: Mandate of Heaven DLC-off fallback
scenarios.playset: current main-only with Mandate of Heaven disabled
steps: Record launcher DLC state, take the normal fallback path, and complete the mandate-claim mission.
Inspect rewards, modifiers, reform list, and CB list; save/reload.
acceptance: Fallback modifiers and task rewards work without the DLC.
Hakko imperial reform and CB do not appear.
No unknown DLC-bound object error is logged.

scenarios.title: Companion map full rendering and history acceptance
scenarios.fixture: new campaigns and official bookmark/date selections only
steps: Inspect key islands, ports, straits, unit/fleet positions, labels, and all 12 official bookmarks.
Exercise all 19 visible map/regional events, 33 map missions, five origins, and 88-province unification; save/reload and run several months.
acceptance: No black province, bad adjacency, wrong port, displaced unit, unreadable label, or history gap.
All event effects land on intended semantic geography.
Save/reload and several months remain stable.

scenarios.title: Release closure and canonical ledger update
steps: Collect every session after EU4 and launcher exit; hash logs, screenshots, and saves.
Rerun main and combined static gates against the exact tested payload.
Update only the canonical ledger with scenario-specific PASS/PENDING/blocked evidence and remaining risks.
acceptance: No TODO is marked DONE beyond its actual scenario evidence.
All exact tested descriptors, versions, hashes, DLC masks, and playsets are recorded.
Fresh logs contain no JXP blocker pattern.
